text:
[Council File 26-0005-S181; CD 13]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to removing the property at 3000 West Crestmoore Place (Case Nos. 44287; 426933; 707367), Assessor I.D. No. 5458-029-022, from the Rent Escrow Account Program (REAP).
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the Housing Department (LAHD) report dated September 4, 2026, attached to the Council file, and ADOPT the accompanying RESOLUTION removing the property at 3000 West Crestmoore Place (Case Nos. 44287; 426933; 707367), Assessor I.D. No. 5458-029-022, from the REAP.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the LAHD. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: The city will remove 3000 West Crestmoore Place from the Rent Escrow Account Program, allowing the property owner to regain control.
